ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio with a dominant low-intensity (black) background (~80%) interspersed with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters (~20%) forming a high-contrast speckled distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Densely packed, non-contiguous high-contrast circular blobs (diameters 5-15 pixels) distributed uniformly across the visible surface of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression; central vertex is partially submerged but upper limbs indicate an acute angle of approximately 20 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire visible trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher pixel-amplitude variations (peaks up to 15 pixels) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep from the medial notch toward the distal tips; curve is more pronounced on the trailing edge of the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extremely high density of circular, high-contrast pixel clusters (white rings on black background) covering >75% of the visible ventral fluke area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged morphology on both distal tips, specifically a prominent cluster of raised, high-intensity pixel masses on the far-right tip consistent with heavy barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: The uniformity and extreme density of the white-on-black rosette patterning is a primary distinctive visual characteristic.
